description: The file defines a PHP class 'Cart' in the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Api' namespace. It manages API endpoints related to shopping cart operations such as adding products, retrieving cart contents, and totals for an OpenCart e-commerce application.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for managing shopping cart operations in an OpenCart e-commerce site.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to handle adding multiple products to the cart with validation.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a single product to the cart with validation.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products currently in the cart along with subscription info.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total cost and taxes for the cart.
